name: PALASS
description: PALASS (PLSS) is a community test token launched on Robinhood Chain testnet through the vibe/vibe launchpad. It is the on-chain mascot of a small Indonesian airdrop-farming crew documenting their testnet journey in public: launch honestly, trade fairly, no promises and no real funds - testnet only. Holders are fellow testers exploring bonding curves together ahead of the vibe/vibe mainnet.
